description.p: Etiketto designs labels with text, images and codes, shows them exactly as they will be printed and prints them over the network, on endless tape or on die-cut labels. It talks to each printer in its own language.

ul.li: Finds the printer on the network by itself and shows its state
Endless tape as long as the content or with a fixed length; die-cut labels in common or custom sizes
Text in any installed font, images and photos, QR codes and barcodes
Background colours and images printed edge to edge, borders
Live preview at print resolution, millimetres or inches, templates, PNG export
Printer problems explained in plain words, with a way to report a problem
User documentation in English and German
Brother VC-500W (also sold as ColAura): colour labels on ZINK tape, with cassette detection, vivid colours and cut modes
Brother P-touch tape printers (PT-P700, PT-P750W, PT-P900 series and others): black on TZe tape and heat-shrink tube, with tape detection, cut and chain printing
cab EOS2, EOS5, SQUIX 4 and MACH 4S: die-cut labels in black, with a check of the loaded roll
Any printer the system knows through CUPS or IPP, such as office printers: one label per page at its exact size

description.p: Etiketto is not affiliated with Brother Industries or cab Produkttechnik. Brother, ColAura, VC-500W, P-touch, TZe, HSe, cab, EOS, SQUIX and MACH are trademarks of their owners; ZINK is a trademark of ZINK Holdings LLC.

description.p: Packaging update, no changes to the app itself.

ul.li: Installing with pip now also installs the desktop entry, icons, MIME type, metainfo and translations
A broken translation stops the build instead of being skipped
Design labels with text, images, QR codes and barcodes; automatic or fixed length
Finds the printer on the network and shows the inserted cassette, remaining tape and firmware
Exact print geometry with edge-to-edge backgrounds and a safety margin per printer
Vivid, standard and black-and-white modes, colour adjustment, full, half or no cut
Clear error messages, cassette age hint, report a problem from the app
Available in 27 languages
